title: LocalAI/nav.json
description: The order of the sidebar: built-in entries, groups and your own links. New chat, Chats, the settings entries and the search always stay; this file cannot move, rename or hide them. Without this file the sidebar shows its default order.

items.description: The sidebar from top to bottom. A built-in entry is {id}, a group is {group}, a link is {type, page|chat|url}. A built-in entry that is not listed is added after the last item in the default order, so a short list never loses an entry. An id the server does not know is ignored.

id.title: Built-in entry
id.description: One of: home, files, pages, agents, connections, memory, skills, models, addons. Home cannot be hidden.

group.title: Group
group.description: A section title. The items after it, up to the next group, are listed under it.

type.title: Link type
type.description: page opens one of your pages, chat opens one conversation, url opens an address in a new tab after the person confirms.

page.title: Page
page.description: For a page link: the name of a page, the folder pages/<name>/ of your home.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: For a chat link: the id of the chat.

url.title: Address
url.description: For a url link: an http or https address without a user name or password.

label.title: Label
label.description: The name shown in the sidebar. For a built-in entry it replaces the default name; leave it out to keep the default.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: An icon name such as file-code, chat or globe. Used by links; a built-in entry keeps its own icon.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: true takes a built-in entry out of the sidebar. Home cannot be hidden.
